title: Forbidden Planet
description: An astronaut (Leslie Nielsen) and crew land on Altair-4 in 2200 and find a mad doctor (Walter Pidgeon), his daughter (Anne Francis) and Robby the robot.

title: Mrs. Miniver
description: William Wyler's Oscar-winning classic about the tensions faced by a family of hard-working Brits in war-torn England.

title: Chuck Amuck: The Movie
description: Animator Chuck Jones traces his role in the evolution of such characters as Bugs Bunny and details the animation process.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Rabbit of Seville
Bugs and Elmer Fudd stage a bizarre version of "The Barber of Seville" after Elmer chases Bugs into a packed theater.

title: One Froggy Evening
description: A man tries desperately to strike it rich with a talented frog that can sing and dance, but the owner is the only one who ever sees it perform.

title: Gay Purr-ee
description: A starry-eyed cat grows weary of life on a French farm and heads for the excitement of 1890s Paris, followed by her tomcat suitor, Jaune-Tom, and his furry cohort, Robespierre.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Duck Amuck
Daffy Duck is tormented by an animator's hand, who constantly changes locations, props and traps for Daffy to fall into.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
What's Opera, Doc?
Elmer Fudd is hunting Bugs Bunny and chases him into an opera where they act out their characters.

title: The Phantom Tollbooth
description: A bored schoolboy (Butch Patrick) drives a toy car into a cartoon land, the Kingdom of Wisdom. Animated/live action.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
The Scarlet Pumpernickle
Daffy Duck wants to become a daredevil, aspiring to be as clever as a fox like his storybook heroes.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Haredevil Hare
Bugs gets blasted into space and makes it all the way up to the moon.

title: Vertigo
description: A former San Francisco detective (James Stewart) who dreads heights falls for a woman (Kim Novak) he is hired to protect.

title: Murder on the Waterfront
description: A Nazi spy tries to steal a top-secret Navy thermostat on the West Coast.

title: Chandler
description: A private eye (Warren Oates) is hired to follow a mobster's former mistress (Leslie Caron).

title: The Story of Three Loves
description: A ballerina (Moira Shearer) risks her life; a governess (Leslie Caron) is wooed by her charge; an aerialist (Kirk Douglas) finds a new partner.

title: Gaby
description: A ballerina (Leslie Caron) falls in love with a U.S. paratrooper (John Kerr) on a two-day pass in World War II London.

title: The Glass Slipper
description: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

title: Lili
description: A French teen (Leslie Caron) joins a carnival and meets a lying magician (Jean-Pierre Aumont) and a loving puppeteer (Mel Ferrer).

title: Gigi
description: An heir (Louis Jourdan) finds that he wants to marry the teen (Leslie Caron) groomed to be his mistress in Gay '90s Paris.

title: An American in Paris
description: An American soldier (Gene Kelly) stays in Paris after World War II to paint and falls in love with a French beauty (Leslie Caron).

title: The Shining
description: A writer goes mad while serving as caretaker with his wife and clairvoyant son at a snowbound Colorado hotel.

title: Full Metal Jacket
description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
description: A doctor (Tom Cruise) explores his relationship with his wife (Nicole Kidman) by delving into a sensual underworld.

title: The Rules of the Game
description: André is having an affair with Christine, whose husband Robert is himself hiding a mistress. Christine's married maid is romantically entangled with the local poacher. At a hunting party, the passions of servants and aristocrats dangerously collide.

title: Dark Delusion
description: Dr. Gillespie's (Lionel Barrymore) young colleague (James Craig) treats an heiress (Lucille Bremer) for insanity against her family's wishes.

title: So You Think You're a Nervous Wreck
description: Joe McDoakes dreams of conquering his fear of his boss.

title: Gaslight
description: A Scotland Yard detective (Joseph Cotten) figures out why a schizoid Victorian (Charles Boyer) is trying to drive his wife (Ingrid Bergman) mad.

title: High Wall
description: A mental-hospital psychiatrist (Audrey Totter) helps a dazed ex-bomber pilot (Robert Taylor) found next to his strangled wife.

title: Bewitched
description: A psychiatrist (Edmund Gwenn) hypnotizes a killer (Phyllis Thaxter) on the eve of her execution, revealing an alter ego to blame.

title: Mental Poise
description: When a psychoanalyst's new patient turns out to be the spitting image of him, it soon becomes difficult to determine who is the doctor and who is the patient.

title: Experiment Perilous
description: A doctor (George Brent) frees a young woman (Hedy Lamarr) from her devious philanthropist husband (Paul Lukas).

title: The Two Mrs. Carrolls
description: A London artist (Humphrey Bogart) poisons his first wife with glasses of milk, then tries it with his second wife (Barbara Stanwyck).

title: Where Danger Lives
description: A doctor (Robert Mitchum) flees to Mexico with a suicidal woman (Faith Domergue), leaving her dead husband (Claude Rains) behind.

title: Bedlam
description: A portly lord (Billy House) sends an 18th-century London actress (Anna Lee) to a madman's (Boris Karloff) insane asylum.

title: The Tramp and the Dictator
description: Charles Chaplin's spoof of Adolf Hitler in the film "The Great Dictator" provokes both hilarity and horror. Narrated by Kenneth Branagh.

title: The Great Dictator
description: Dictator Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.

title: To Be or Not to Be
description: Joseph and his acting troupe must confuse the Nazis and stop Professor Siletsky from handing over a list of Polish resistance members.

title: The Producers
description: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."

title: Once Upon a Honeymoon
description: A U.S. reporter (Cary Grant) in Europe lets a former Brooklyn stripper (Ginger Rogers) know she has just married a Nazi (Walter Slezak).

title: Which Way to the Front?
description: A 4-F billionaire and his odd squad go to Italy in his yacht and capture a Nazi general.

title: Hold Your Man
description: A con man (Clark Gable) on the run hides out in an apartment and meets his new girlfriend (Jean Harlow).

title: China Seas
description: A steamer captain (Clark Gable) moves gold with his ex-lover, a blonde (Jean Harlow) and a pirate boss (Wallace Beery) on board.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E13 — The Wizard's Challenge
The Dynamic Duo race to the estate of Dr. Hammil to stop the Wizard's gang from stealing the neutralizing device.

title: Dr. Kildare's Wedding Day
description: Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) snaps Kildare (Lew Ayres) back to reality after his bride, nurse Lamont (Laraine Day), is hit by a truck.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Trial of Mr. Wolf
The case of the Big Bad Wolf versus Little Red Riding Hood is presented to a jury of wolves.

title: The Three Little Bops
description: Three pigs' careers as a jazz band are disrupted by a wolf they rejected for membership.

title: Roberta
description: An American jazzman (Fred Astaire) and his buddy woo a Russian princess (Irene Dunne) and a fake countess (Ginger Rogers) in Paris.

title: Limelight
description: A has-been music-hall clown (Charles Chaplin) helps a suicidal ballerina (Claire Bloom) become the toast of 1917 London.

title: The Late Show
description: An over-the-hill Los Angeles private eye (Art Carney) solves a murder with a wacky woman (Lily Tomlin) who has lost her cat.

title: The Last Run
description: A retired mob getaway driver (George C. Scott) agrees to take a fugitive (Tony Musante) across the Spanish border to France.

title: La cage aux folles
description: A gay nightclub owner (Ugo Tognazzi) and his partner (Michel Serrault) impersonate a straight couple when one's son brings his fiancée's parents home.

title: Some Like It Hot
description: To evade gangsters, two men (Tony Curtis, Jack Lemmon) don skirts and makeup and join an all-girl band with a sizzling singer (Marilyn Monroe).

title: Ace in the Hole
description: A New York newsman (Kirk Douglas) in New Mexico delays a cave-in victim's rescue to milk the story.

title: Taste the Blood of Dracula
description: Victorian thrill-seekers kill the vampire's (Christopher Lee) helper; he seduces their daughters to get even.

title: Dracula A.D. 1972
description: Professor Van Helsing Jr. (Peter Cushing) protects his granddaughter (Stephanie Beacham) from the vampire count (Christopher Lee), brought back by London hippies.
